slides.headline: 1) PHOTOGRAPH ANYTHING AND GET AN EXPERT ANSWER IN 10 SECONDS
slides.body: A SPECIALIST USED TO COST $200 AN HOUR. NOW YOU POINT YOUR PHONE AT ANYTHING AND GET THE SAME ANSWER FOR FREE. HOW TO: 1. Open the ChatGPT app (free on iPhone + Android) — tap the camera icon inside the text bar 2. Photograph anything: a contract clause, a car warning light, a bill in another language 3. Type "explain this in plain English" — it answers the way a specialist would
slides.image: Screenshot of the ChatGPT app on iPhone — camera icon in the text bar highlighted with a red arrow, real UI, no mockup

slides.headline: 2) UPLOAD ANY CONTRACT. AI FINDS THE PARTS THAT HURT YOU
slides.body: MOST PEOPLE SIGN LEASES AND JOB OFFERS WITHOUT READING EVERY LINE. AI READS THE WHOLE THING IN 3 SECONDS AND FLAGS EXACTLY WHAT TO WORRY ABOUT. HOW TO: 1. Go to claude.ai (free — sign up with just your email) 2. Click the paperclip icon next to the chat bar and upload any PDF 3. Type: "Find any clauses that could hurt me and explain them in simple words"
slides.image: Screenshot of Claude.ai with a PDF lease loaded — AI response visible listing flagged clauses in plain English, real screenshot

slides.headline: 3) TALK TO IT OUT LOUD. IT TALKS BACK IN REAL TIME
slides.body: CHATGPT'S VOICE MODE IS A FULL TWO-WAY SPOKEN CONVERSATION — IT LISTENS, THINKS, AND ANSWERS BACK LIKE A PHONE CALL WITH SOMEONE WHO KNOWS EVERYTHING. HOW TO: 1. Open the ChatGPT app on your phone (free on iPhone + Android) 2. Tap the waveform icon in the bottom right corner 3. Speak naturally — ask anything, interrupt it, tell it to slow down or go deeper
slides.image: Screenshot of ChatGPT Advanced Voice Mode — animated orb visible, waveform icon highlighted with a red arrow

slides.headline: 4) DESCRIBE A WEBSITE. GET THE REAL WORKING THING IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: A DEVELOPER WOULD CHARGE $1,000 TO $5,000 TO BUILD THIS. CLAUDE WRITES THE SAME WORKING CODE IN UNDER A MINUTE — NO TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE NEEDED. HOW TO: 1. Go to claude.ai (free) 2. Type: "Build me a one-page website for [your business]. Include a contact form and a short paragraph about what I do" 3. Copy the code → save it as a file called index.html → go to netlify.com/drop → drag the file in → site is live
slides.image: Side-by-side screenshot: Claude chat showing HTML code on the left, the rendered live website on the right — real output, no mockup

slides.headline: 5) UPLOAD YOUR BANK STATEMENT. AI MAPS WHERE EVERY DOLLAR WENT
slides.body: MOST PEOPLE GUESS WHERE THEIR MONEY GOES. AI READS EVERY TRANSACTION AND SHOWS YOU EXACTLY — IN SECONDS. HOW TO: 1. Log into your bank → find "Export" or "Download" under Statements → save as a CSV file 2. Go to chatgpt.com or claude.ai → click the paperclip icon → attach the file 3. Type: "What did I spend the most on this month, and what should I cut?"
slides.image: Screenshot of ChatGPT or Claude showing a spending breakdown by category generated from an uploaded bank CSV — categories and amounts clearly visible
